description:
Fair Deal Property New Homes Division are delighted to present to you for sale Number 4 Leacach Ard

This is the last remaining home in what is  an exceptional boutique development of outstanding next-generation homes located in the heart of Loughrea town.

Number 4 occupies a superior position within the development and benefits from a larger site with side access along with additional car parking space.

Leacach Ard represents a rare opportunity to acquire a truly future-proofed home where exceptional construction quality, cutting-edge energy performance, and thoughtfully designed living spaces combine to create an entirely new benchmark for modern residential living.

Extending to approximately 200 square metres, these superb A2-rated homes are constructed using advanced ICF (Insulated Concrete Formwork) technology together with solid poured concrete construction throughout, delivering remarkable levels of thermal efficiency, structural integrity, durability, and soundproofing far beyond what is typically expected in a new build home.

Designed with modern family living and long-term flexibility in mind, each home features expansive accommodation over three floors, including a substantial 30 square metre basement level ideally suited for a gym, home office, cinema room, studio apartment conversion, or multi-generational living arrangement.

These homes offer a level of quality and specification rarely seen on the market, including:

Concrete floors across all three levels
Underfloor heating throughout all three floors
Exceptionally high thermal and acoustic performance
Spacious, intelligently designed interiors with superb flow and flexibility
Solid concrete construction delivering superior build quality
Private internal parking with stairwell access to the living space
Additional external parking
Beautifully appointed low-maintenance exteriors with artificial grass, outdoor power points, and feature lighting

The generously proportioned living accommodation is flooded with natural light and designed around contemporary open-plan living, with expansive living spaces overlooking private patio areas and gardens.

Accommodation has been carefully curated to provide exceptional comfort and flexibility and includes:

Two luxurious master bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms
Along with two further double bedrooms.
Beautifully presented family bathroom with contemporary fixtures and fittings.
Ground floor guest WC
Extensive storage and flexible-use spaces
Interiors perfectly suited to evolving family needs and multi-generational living

Every detail within Leacach Ard has been thoughtfully considered to create homes that are elegant, energy efficient, exceptionally comfortable, and built to stand the test of time.

These outstanding homes also qualify for the Help to Buy Grant, making them an exceptional opportunity for purchasers seeking premium quality modern homes in one of Galway’s most sought-after locations.

Leacach Ard is more than a new homes development, it is a statement in quality, innovation, and exceptional standards of modern living in the heart of Loughrea.
